decayAlert.rule: Three disjoint 30-market blocks worse than market-mid Brier; diagnostic only, not proof of decay

researchCalibration.reason: Need 300 resolved prior markets and 100 held-out markets; late-known labels are purged

execution.limitation: Polling timestamps bound observation latency; they are not matching-engine event times. Zero fills does not establish execution quality.

factor.limitation: Near-full-day marked equity intervals; days with declared external flows excluded. Undeclared transfers cannot be corrected automatically.
